data.name: Elaheh
data.gender_notes: Elaheh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Elaheh is derived from the Arabic word 'Allah', meaning 'The One God'. It is a name used to express deep reverence and devotion to the divine. The name Elaheh carries the meaning “God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Persian. Parents who choose Elaheh usually hope their child will grow to embody god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elaheh is a name that evokes a sense of connection to the divine. It is a reminder of the presence of God in all aspects of life and a call to remember and honor that presence.
data.etymology: Elaheh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elaheh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
